notes.title: Fractals 1 Visuals Released! (and big AI VJ update coming!)
notes.notes:
Reality is constituted by mathematics!

Add over 350 Fractal art visuals to AI-VJ, from across 12 different styles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3974340/AIVJ__Fractals_1_Visuals/

Show them beauty they can count on!

(Also, - as a teaser - a big AI VJ update is nearly finished! Stay tuned next week for in-app DLC installs and several fixes!)

These visuals are pre-generated for optimum performance, carefully selected and manually tweaked for artistic quality, by an experienced DJ

The visuals are recorded at 60fps, which is double the normal video framerate, to ensure smooth visuals at every BPM. The total unique runtime of all visuals together is over 40 minutes. With some duplicate plays that's standard practice in VJ sets, this package is more than enough for a two hour long DJ set

After installing the DLC you can add these visuals to your deck through the "Visuals" top menu

Unlike the Live Fractal Visuals, these are pre-generated. Them being 3D, and much more intricate, made this unavoidable

(We're also happy to let you know that these visuals were created using green energy)

notes.title: The Decks and Sets update!; accessible via tabs; all drag & droppable + more!
notes.notes:
The big update: Decks and Sets are here, for organizing and accessing more visuals with ease!

And two feature requests were fulfilled, and several reported bugs fixed!

Decks and Sets have arrived!:

Decks are what's currently a whole screen of banks with visuals, and sets are a collection of decks.

These can now be accessed through tabs at the top of the screen, moved around through drag & drop, and played whole. Giving you many more levels of control over your VJ show!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046679/2acc65c6b4a9a4a5a7428fb62e78eb2f213cbcb9.png

You can now import DLCs as a whole deck, and thus more easily switch between them during a show. 

And a whole set of decks can even play in shuffle-mode so while providing coherent style / thematic blocks of visuals, the whole thing can still run hands-free!

Oh and you can drop visuals or whole banks on decks, and even move decks between sets, or even whole sets by simply dragging and dropping. The kind of easy control that makes creativity flow naturally!

Another feature added are duplicate buttons for decks and banks. They make it easier to create multiple versions of your favorite decks or banks, without having to re-import them (requested by Habbening).

Logo DLC: now multiple DJ logos!:

- For those with the Customize Your DJ Logo DLC: It is now possible to have multiple DJ logos, and switch between them (feature request by Habbening).

Every deck added to the Flash Banner, Small Logo, or Big Logo sets now can be selected from the Logos menu to be the one activated when the logo buttons are pressed / enabled.

Handy when there's a line-up of multiple DJs for the night!

And a lot of smaller fixes:

- An overhaul of the playback selection code. Much less complex now thanks to some state keeping in sets, decks, and banks themselves, and thus easier to build upon, and less prone to hangups now.

- Fixed a bug that caused the app to crash if all visuals were removed from logos (Logo DLC, reported by u_space). Also fixed a similar issue when all visuals were removed from the main banks.

- If somehow all logos get deleted, it will now automatically restore them, and in the worst case of the save file missing / being corrupted, restore to the default decks & logos

- Now hides notices if the settings section is open

- Dozens of smaller fixes

This update was in the making for months, and has been the biggest since release. We hope no major bugs were introduced with it. And we ran it for hours to make sure it's reliable. But there's always a chance. Please report bugs on our Discord!

Note that due to an overhaul of some of the naming, it might be necessary to run a "Restore Default Set and Logos" before everything works as expected, especially with regards to sample visuals & logos.

Join us on Discord!:

Feature requests & bug reports are welcome. Either here or on our discord!

notes.title: Logo DLC now supports video, no more banner, menu overhaul + bug fixes
notes.notes:
Three feature requests fulfilled this week, and several reported bugs fixed!

Logo DLC video logos!:

- For those with the Customize Your DJ Logo DLC: Videos can now be loaded onto the logo decks, and will play just like image logos (feature request by Habbening).

They're shown transparently on top of any visuals playing at 50% alpha for now. In a later update you'll be able to adjust this, & we'll also be adding support for logos of multiple DJs.

No more banner!:

- For everyone: The AI VJ banner that appears once every 20 minutes can now be disabled from the DJ Logos menu! 

Previously requiring the Logo DLC for this was something that seemed to make business sense, but didn't sit quite right with me. A review by DarkSeraph made me reconsider & drop that requirement.

So now AI VJ is fully usable as a free VJ app.

The Logo DLC for logos & adding your own banners is something we keep though.

Logo buttons are a 'nice to have' convenience feature that even Resolume (at € 299) doesn't have as such, and that any performing DJ (with a logo) should easily be able to afford after using AI VJ without a logo (or with a logo loaded onto a visuals Bank) for a night.

Also note that income from DLCs goes directly towards development; AI VJ so far is still mostly a labour of love that I'm using for my own shows, rather than something that's making me a living wage.

Adding support for logo videos was good preparation for adding layer support for all visuals, in a future update. We'll have to finish some other updates first before this can happen.

Yet with this update we're moving (allbeit slowly, and with a small step) towards our aim of becoming the easiest to use (free) VJ app!

And a lot of smaller fixes:

- An overhaul of the menu (feature request / report by Anne).

The menu needed updating for the new Unity version, and in the process we have improved consistency, and visual effects such as the tick-marks with selected settings, and making the sub-menu arrows point in the right (left) direction.

- A bug that occasionally caused switching between full-screen & windowed mode to be unreliable was nipped. Having to dive into the ancient Windows DLLs that deal with this again was not pretty. But it should work more consistently now.

- A bug with the logos & AI VJ banner having an unwanted line at the top has been fixed. As well as a bug making grey squares sometimes appear, and a rare bug in the frequency of the appearance of the banner when enabled & its ordering with regard to the logos.

- The fractals appearing too small at first play for 6 seconds on certain screen setups now no longer happens.

- Spout output settings are now saved with the settings.

Join us on Discord!:

Feature requests & bug reports are welcome. Either here or on our discord!

notes.title: Version numbers, Unity update, back-end work
notes.notes:
Flowery 4k visuals this Friday!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3185970/AIVJ__Flowery_4k_Visuals/

Work on the tabbed decks update is underway:

This update is mostly behind the scenes stuff. It's in preparation of the major update expanding the UI, to allow multiple tabbed decks with banks, and then visuals. This will make it easier to organize visuals.

And while that is still weeks off from being finished, we've decided to already release what we can. While a lot of the preparatory back-end work had already been done, this update changes where thumbnails of included visuals and DLC are stored: No longer in a temp-folder on the system, but within the app. This makes updates cleaner, and saves a hit for copying them over, on first load.

Besides this especially the Unity update (to 6000.0.20) was good to get done.

The most notable change for you probably is that AI VJ now has a version number. Its displayed in the lower right corner of the screen. It makes identifying potential issues easier, and internally it will help with things like save file updates, and the like. And as you can see, they're on the update artwork too!

Join us on Discord!:

Other feature requests & bug reports are welcome. Either here or on our discord!

notes.title: Update: Moveable windows, Unity 6, license & tutorials
notes.notes:
This update seemed simple. Supporting windowed mode for display 2...

Well, Unity basically doesn't support multi display setups. I mean you can open them.

But if you want to have them windowed as opposed to fullscreen, or to have a UI on the second display, forget it. It couldn't even translate mouse positions to click buttons on display 2 correctly.

Well luckily; not quite forget it...

After updating to Unity 6 for minor improvements on this front, I went around Unity, and addressed windows DLLs directly to get it done. A week later, I know more than I'd ever wanted about how Windows does its window business. Down to repositioning borderless windows, and calculating, scaling and correcting mouse positions so they are translated to window space.

Anyway I'm not letting anything get in the way of your user experience!

For this update we again have 2 feature requests fulfilled!:

- First is the aforementioned moveable windows. You can now set them to windowed, and drag them around. AI VJ even remembers whether you preferred them full-screen or windowed. Saving their position may be added later if you want it (thanks Moinvibes and Piotr!)

- The second feature request fulfilled is a license for the use of the visuals and software. In short AI VJ can be used for any kind of performance, and visuals can be used to create music videos and streams! This license, as well as the tutorials are now linked from the main menu (thanks maplesyrupghost).

- Finally we've upgraded to Unity 6. Which means some optimizations, and that we're ready for the future. As while not perfect, Unity does many things well!

I've tested the app several times. But be in touch if there's any bugs!

Join us on Discord!:

Other feature requests & bug reports are welcome. Either here or on our discord!

notes.title: Update: Nudge adjust, tapping BPM, and chill slow mode!
notes.notes:
From now on updates will be mostly done during the first half of the week

For people with a gig or party on the weekend being notified of an update just before going live in front of an audience is not ideal. Even if updates were always to be bug-free. While Friday updates were pleasant for me for the excitement of sharing an improved AI VJ, from now most will be between Monday and Wednesday, about every other week.

For this update we have 2 feature requests fulfilled, and several more things added:

- Nudging the visuals timing to an adjustable number of milliseconds before, or after the predicted beat is now possible! So on a wide range of hardware you can get the timing exactly right! Especially recommended with Ableton Link Sync to get that last bit of precision (thanks Henk and Moinvibes for the request!)

- Manually tapping the beat is now another way to let AI VJ know what the BPM is. This is how dedicated VJs have been doing it for decades. And now AI VJ can also work with their routines (thanks Henk!)

- In addition the tapped BPM can also be fed as a hint to the Audio Sync, and then be aligned with audio onsets for a more dynamic approach where you can correct the Audio Sync

- A slow mode has been added for calmer nights at home. Just click the cute little snail!

- A full screen button has been added to the UI. So hiding the UI for operation on a single screen is immediately accessible!

And we've applied a host of smaller fixes:
- updated splash screen
- some spelling fixes
- issue with empty notices fixed

notes.title: Update: Loop mode, audio auto-detect, and better button icon animations!
notes.notes:
After a cheerful launch that uncovered no show stopping bugs, our first regular update is here!

Quality of life improvements, and 2 fulfilled feature requests!:

- Banks of visuals can now be set in loop mode. This means that when played, only visuals from that bank will be played / cycled. It won't jump to the next. Handy for that special song, or for the picture slide-show at a private event! (thanks djm.s.n for requesting it in our discord!)

- Audio devices are now automatically detected on start for new installs, and everyone who hasn't manually selected anything else. This makes starting the app sufficient to start the party!

- We've subtly improved our buttons. With different images & not just different colors, for pressed & unpressed states, it should be much clearer now which button is pressed and which isn't. And with the backdrop shadows, they should stand out a little better against light videos

- In full screen mode we've added a close window X in the top right corner! Added a windowed mode button as well. Easy for getting to the desktop, or closing things up after a grand show! (thanks Filip!)

And we've applied a host of smaller fixes:
- reduced the time it takes for tooltips to show
- added notices about state of the art real time BPM detection being 75% correct at best
- when audio falls silent for over 5 seconds, it now returns to 120bpm instead of going wild
- dealth with a crash that sometimes happens on exit
- updated a link from the menu

Requests for feedback:

Note that banks set to loopmode will be skipped when playing other banks in global shuffle mode. This to avoid the shuffle from getting stuck in their loops

Also it makes sense as looping banks tend to be used for special content, which you'd not want to show up in shuffle play anyway

This seems to be the most logical way to implement this. Let us know if you think differently

Other feature requests & bug reports are welcome. Either here or in our discord!
